vision.name: Supreme Kai's Ki Blast
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 1.
[Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
Search your Life Deck or discard pile for an Ally and play it or search your Banished Zone for a [Trait:God] Ally and place it into play at 5 stages above 0.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
(Banish after use.)
